records.title: INITIATIVES TO REDUCE URBAN POLLUTION
details:
967.63 Kms Metro
Rails/Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS) are under construction in various cities; The
operational metro rail network length in the State of Haryana is 40.62 km, while an
additional 28.5 km is under construction.
Out of 375 buses, 50 e-Buses are
currently operational and the remaining buses are scheduled to be made operational by the
end of March 2026.
